claim_results.claim: 2. Milling an empty library does not lose the game (CR 704.5b is a draw rule)
claim_results.evidence: probe empty_library_mill: 0 Milled, life 20, outcome None, drew_from_empty false; probe ruin_crab_mill_short_libraries_are_harmless (one opponent with an empty library, game continues)

claim_results.claim: 3. Stitcher's Supplier mills on ETB and again on death
claim_results.evidence: probe supplier_mills_again_when_it_dies: Bolt, dead Supplier, then exactly 3 milled cards (library left with the remaining cards), 3 Milled events, 1 Destroyed of the Supplier. The shipped test also lands on the post-trigger state: before the dies trigger resolves the graveyard holds only [Bolt, Supplier], so its 5-card assertion can only be reached after the mill.

findings.claim: The commit message and decks/package-slice5-mill.txt line 1 both call it a '40-card PACKAGE fixture', and every other decks/package-*.txt is exactly 40 cards
findings.evidence: for f in decks/package-*.txt; do grep -E '^[0-9]+ ' $f | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s}'; done -> ayula 40, cross 40, krenko 40, soul-warden 40, talrand 40, tatyova 40, package-slice5-mill 50; selfplay report seats[].cards = 50
findings.fix: Either trim package-slice5-mill.txt to 40 cards (e.g. 4+4+4+4+3+3 new cards + 4 Grizzly Bears + 4 Runeclaw Bear + 10 lands) or reword the file header and commit/PR text to '50-card package fixture'.

findings.claim: 7: 'Preordain's scry-2-then-draw really orders then draws (not draw-then-scry)' — the shipped focused test is offered as the proof
findings.evidence: crates/core/tests/issue17_slice5.rs:372-418 uses auto_answer, which always keeps viewed cards on top; with effects reversed to [Draw(1), Scry(2)] the same asserts still pass (draw Island, then scry Forest+Mountain keeping both -> library [Forest, Mountain], hand [Island]). The behaviour itself is correct: review/probe_slice5.rs preordain_orders_then_draws prints Scried -> OrderedCard(false) -> OrderedCard(true) -> Draw Forest.
findings.fix: Make the test order-sensitive: assert the log position of Event::Scried precedes the first Event::Draw, or answer Pending::OrderCard with to_top=false for the first viewed card and assert the drawn card is the second (the review probe shows both).

findings.claim: 4/6: each-opponent effects should be applied in APNAP order (CR 101.4)
findings.evidence: probe ruin_crab_mills_each_live_opponent_only with P1 active prints mill event order [0,0,0,2,2,2] — seat order from seat 0 — where APNAP from the active seat would mill P2 before P0. No gameplay consequence (mills and damage are simultaneous, no replacement effects), and Effect::DamageEachOpponent has the same pre-existing shape.
findings.fix: Optional: iterate opponents as (seat + n - active) % n like the CR 903.9a / APNAP queues do, so the event log order matches the rules; otherwise record the deviation in HANDOFF.md's not-implemented list.
